PT366.content: The Osirian addressee places Isis on his phallus; seed enters her; she is sharp/ready as Sopdet/Sothis; Horus emerges in a Sopdet-linked form.
PT366.source: Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae PT 366, Teti/Pepi I witnesses

PT442.content: Osiris comes as Sꜣḥ/Orion in an Old Kingdom Pyramid Text composition.

lane_2_khoiak_recovery_clock.boundary: THE VARIANT LISTS PLACE THE PHALLUS ON DAY 25 OR DAY 28; THIS IS RITUAL CHRONOLOGY, NOT THE HISTORICAL DATE OF A MYTHIC EVENT.

dendera_lunar_operator.claim: The Dendera Khoiak mysteries begin on IV Akhet 12, identified in the scholarly edition/discussion with the seventh lunar day dnj.t; the sixteen relics are explicitly connected in the Khoiak text with the work of dnj.t.

sirius_calendar_operator.claim: The heliacal rising of Sopdet/Sirius is an annual event and is discussed in the Ebers calendar as a calendrical anchor/herald relative to month reckoning.
sirius_calendar_operator.source: Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae discussion of the Ebers calendar

dendera_astral_myth_alignment.claim: Priskin's Dendera-zodiac study interprets astral aspects of the Osiris/Isis/Horus myth in relation to lunar phases, the annual solar cycle and the heliacal rising of Sirius, while also discussing the Khoiak mysteries.
